images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: exploratory abstract editorial illustration for the README of Transit, programmable versioned data infrastructure for applications.
Primary request: Represent "continuity through change" as a living weave. Convey connected information becoming useful structure, transformation with retained history, and the ability to follow how a result came to be.
Subject: A single elegant woven surface floating in open space. Individually distinguishable fine strands gather into an ordered, supple textile-like field, then gently change direction and rhythm to produce a new coherent pattern. Their continuity stays visually legible throughout the transformation. Two faint offset impressions beneath the main surface suggest earlier states that remain present. A few stronger strands let the eye trace a route across the changing surface. Spacing and deliberate open regions give the whole composition a sense of governed freedom.
Style/medium: Sophisticated abstract editorial art, tactile ink and translucent paper qualities, precise but organic linework, restrained printmaking texture. Expressive and simple enough to recognize at README width.
Composition/framing: Wide landscape composition, generous negative space, one clear focal transformation, a graceful continuous gesture. Airy light background, restrained color, strong silhouette.
Text: None.
Avoid: machinery, gears, rails, trains, pipes, computers, database cylinders, literal architecture diagrams, arrows, labels, node-link graphs, futuristic glowing circuitry, neon gradients, glossy glass blocks, infinity symbols, visual clutter. This is an evocative brand concept, not a technical feature diagram.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: abstract editorial illustration for the Transit project README, part of a three-image series about programmable versioned data infrastructure.
Primary request: An evolving landscape that remembers its contours. Represent changing data, retained context and the ability to navigate from evidence toward useful outcomes.
Subject: One floating abstract terrain made entirely from flowing nested contour lines and thin translucent strata. Contours rise and open into gentle ridges and valleys, with subtle offset traces of earlier terrain visible below the current surface. One warm continuous line threads through the contours and makes a legible route across the evolving field. The image should feel like information becoming understandable, with earlier shapes still readable. The geometry is suggestive and nonrepresentational; no actual geographic location.
Style/medium: Sophisticated editorial printmaking on warm ivory paper, fine slate-blue and muted ochre ink lines, delicate translucent paper-like layers, restrained grain. Precise organic curves with generous breathing room. Match the visual language of a light airy ink illustration of a flowing woven field.
Composition/framing: Wide 2:1 landscape image. A single sweeping terrain silhouette across the central band, ample uncluttered paper space above and below, readable at README width. Elegant, calm, and visually distinct from fabric: concentric contour rings and terraced strata instead of interlacing threads.
Text: None.
Avoid: realistic mountains, trees, buildings, literal maps, globes, machinery, gears, trains, database icons, node-link graphs, arrows, text, musical notation, woven textiles, neon glows, glossy glass, heavy dark backgrounds. This is a conceptual metaphor, not a technical diagram.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: abstract editorial illustration for the Transit project README, part of a three-image series about programmable versioned data infrastructure.
Primary request: A musical score becoming a wave. Represent declared structure becoming coordinated activity: several independent parts combine into useful motion while their origins remain visible.
Subject: An abstract band of slender parallel score-like rules and a sparse rhythm of small rectangular ink marks gradually unfurls into flowing, overlapping waveforms. A few lines stay visually continuous all the way through the transformation, from measured structure to expressive synchronized curves. Let the transformation itself be the focal point. A restrained ochre line carries a recurring rhythm amid slate-blue curves. Faint offset echoes retain the underlying pattern. Convey composition, timing, and continuity without illustrating instruments or literal sheet music.
Style/medium: Sophisticated editorial printmaking on warm ivory paper, fine slate-blue and muted ochre ink lines, translucent ink overlaps, restrained paper grain. Precise organic curves, calm and airy, consistent with a light flowing weave illustration and an abstract contour landscape.
Composition/framing: Wide 2:1 landscape image, graceful sweep across the central band, generous negative space above and below, clear at README width. Visually distinct from terrain and fabric: a transformation from sparse orderly geometric marks to smooth rhythmic oscillation.
Text: None.
Avoid: instruments, musicians, treble clefs, recognizable musical notes, letters, equations, arrows, labeled diagrams, audio app UI, headphones, heartbeat monitor look, woven textiles, topographic mountains, machinery, gears, circuitry, neon glows, glossy glass, dark backgrounds. This is a conceptual metaphor, not a technical diagram.

images.concept: Score becoming a wave and an evolving landscape
images.prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: single abstract editorial hero illustration for Transit's README.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target: the score becoming a wave. Image 2 is a supporting reference for the evolving landscape and its contour/strata treatment.
Primary request: Evolve Image 1 into ONE seamless continuous transformation: a measured score becomes flowing waves, and those SAME waves become an evolving landscape.
Composition: Preserve the wide 2:1 aspect ratio, warm ivory paper, restrained slate-blue and ochre colors, generous negative space, fine ink lines and delicate paper texture. Recompose the progression to make all three phases clearly readable: the left quarter has parallel score-like rules and sparse rectangular marks; the middle third has open, smooth rhythmic oscillations; the right portion develops a dimensional landscape of gentle ridges, valleys, concentric contour rings and translucent layered strata inspired by Image 2. The landscape must feel like the waves acquiring depth and becoming terrain, with the very same lines traceable across the transition. Keep a warm ochre line continuous from score through wave into a winding path across the terrain.
History: Faint offset contours under the terrain suggest earlier states that remain inspectable.
Invariants: Preserve Image 1's elegant minimal score geometry and calm editorial character, and keep the transformation airy and legible at README width.
Constraints: One coherent image with smooth overlapping transitions; no panels, dividers, seams or pasted-image collage. No text, arrows, literal musical notes, instruments, buildings, trees, realistic mountains, machinery, database icons, neon or glossy 3D. Do not let the landscape swallow the wave phase; the middle must remain visibly a wave before gaining terrain contours.
